results.title: State law enforcement launches seat belt enforcement campaign

results.title: Judicial inspection authority honors head of Sana'a appeals court, number of divisions, courts, distinguished judges
results.description: The Head of the Judicial Inspection Authority, Judge Dr. Marwan Al-Mahaqeri, honored on Tuesday the Head of the Sana'a Appeals Court, Judge Taha Aqaba, and a number of divisions of appellate courts, primary courts, and distinguished judges from across the Republic.
